note: Trigger-routing suite, minted 2026-07-26 with the skill (issue #97); moved to authorkit 2026-08-14 (issue #197, ADR-0011/D9) with the skill, unedited apart from this note and n03/n04/n09/n10/n12 below. n12 added 2026-08-19 (issue #718) as the reciprocal fence against doctrine-audit's t06 (this skill was stealing doctrine-audit's old-tool-name case 2-of-3 in the #676 sweep); description gained a vocab-term NOT-for clause in the same change. expect=trigger: a CONSUMER repo holds references to retired plugin/skill/agent/command names and wants them found or fixed. expect=no-trigger: near-misses owned elsewhere — choosing a brand-new name (naming-rules, harness), planning or executing a rename inside the plugin repo itself (rename-planning/rename-execute, this plugin; big-change-git-rules, harness), general repo drift (clean-repo), and the routing/description tier (check-routing). Two dangerous confusions this suite measures: fix-old-names vs big-change-git-rules (one runs in the repo that PERFORMED the rename, the other in a repo that merely CONSUMES it), and — new since the move — fix-old-names vs its own in-plugin siblings rename-planning/rename-execute (one repairs a stale REFERENCE post-rename in any installing repo; the other two PLAN/EXECUTE the rename itself, inside the governed estate).
